terms.signIn: By pressing the sign-in button you agree to the <terms>terms of use</terms>. If you are under 18, this also confirms the consent of a parent or guardian.
terms.register: By continuing you agree to the <terms>terms of use</terms>. If you are under 18, this also confirms the consent of a parent or guardian.
terms.heading: Terms of use of the school portal
terms.intro: Dear pupils, students and teachers! The school portal may be used only on the following terms. Every user is bound to keep them.

rules.r1: Opening unnecessary accounts, or accounts unrelated to the work of the school, is strictly forbidden. Signing in with Google works only for accounts the school has registered and confirmed beforehand; any other attempt is refused by the system. To have an account registered, contact the system administrator.
rules.r2: Entering or spreading false information — about the timetable, news and announcements, marks or any other information section — leads to the user's account being blocked and to the appropriate disciplinary measures.
rules.r3: In chats, courtesy is required. Insults, humiliation and any act that harms a person's honour and dignity are forbidden. The portal's messenger is meant only for sharing school information, asking about homework and contacting teachers; personal matters and topics outside school life belong in other messengers.
rules.r4: We ask parents and guardians to check their children's information carefully and to follow it regularly: a child may give wrong information about their marks or absences.
rules.r5: Improper remarks and unfounded objections in comments on news and announcements are forbidden. Send well-founded suggestions and remarks through the system administrator or the teachers' chat.
rules.r6: A mark entered in the system is not restored, raised or changed at a user's request. There are three kinds of absence: excused, unexcused and absent altogether.
rules.r7: Repeated, rapid actions in the system (for example signing in and out of an account many times from one device) are forbidden and lead to the account being blocked.

terms.closing: We respectfully ask each of you to keep these rules fully and in good time, and to act only within the terms of use in force. If they are broken, the system administration may restrict or block the account without prior notice.
